summary: Sprint 0A VERA OS frontend-only smoke + acceptance testing completed. All 7 requested features pass with mock data. Shell (Sidebar/TopBar/Layout), routing, VERA AI briefing, Property list, status filters, text search, and placeholder screens for disabled apps all work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider setting document.title in index.html to 'VERA OS' — currently shows 'Emergent | Fullstack App' which is inconsistent with the product identity (minor branding polish).
PropertiesScreen.tsx (~128 lines) is well within limits; PropertyCard sub-component could be moved to its own file under packages/ui or app/components for reuse when Sprint 0B adds a detail view.
Sidebar uses aria-current='page' correctly on the active item; good accessibility.
Feature flag driven navigation (navigation.ts) is a clean pattern for future sprints — no changes needed.
seed_data_creation: None (in-memory mock via InMemoryPropertyRepository — 6 seeded properties: 4 active, 1 reserved, 1 sold).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 0A is fully green. All data is mock/in-memory (PropertyService + MockAIProvider). Next sprint will likely introduce a backend and property detail screen. Test URL: https://real-estate-os-10.preview.emergentagent.com/propiedades. Data-testids in use: nav-<id>, filter-<all|active|reserved|sold>, property-search-input, property-card-prop-001..006.
